description: Shared dependency policy for Enashka repos. Each repo's renovate.json extends this and adds only its own exceptions.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule and the release-age wait, and are never merged automatically.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all minor and patch updates. Renovate merges it only once every check is green; repos with no checks on GitHub never automerge (Renovate refuses without status checks).
Below 1.0 a minor bump may break: treat it like a major.
Majors open only when ticked on the Dependency Dashboard, and are never automerged.
GitHub Actions in one PR, merged once checks are green.
@futurproche/brand is vendored from the futurproche-brand repo by brand:sync, never updated by Renovate.
